# Kerala Tourism

> > Official Kerala tourism resource featuring tour packages, spiritual pilgrimage centers, backwater experiences, Ayurvedic treatments, and honeymoon destinations across India's southwestern coastal state.

Kerala Tourism (operated by Holidays DNA) provides comprehensive travel planning for Kerala, India, showcasing destinations from the Western Ghats to the Arabian Sea coast. The site specializes in customized tour packages including temple pilgrimages (Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Guruvayoor Temple), backwater cruises on Vembanad Lake, Ayurvedic wellness retreats, and family vacation itineraries across cities like Thiruvananthapuram and Calicut.

## Key Topics

- Kerala backwaters and Vembanad Lake
- Hindu temples and pilgrimage (Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Guruvayoor Temple, Sree Ayyappa)
- Ayurvedic treatments and wellness tourism
- Western Ghats hill stations
- Arabian Sea coastal destinations
- Honeymoon and romantic getaways
- Religious tourism (Hindu, Muslim, Christian centers)
- Customized tour packages and itineraries
- Family vacation planning
- Thiruvananthapuram and Calicut city tours
- Spiritual travel experiences
- Temple tour packages
- Kerala cultural heritage

## Tour Packages & Planning

- [Kerala Tourism Homepage](https://keralatourism.travel/): Main portal for Kerala tours, honeymoon packages, and Ayurvedic wellness experiences
- [Kerala Tour Packages with Price & Itinerary](https://keralatourism.travel/kerala-tour-packages): Comprehensive tour packages featuring backwaters, Ayurveda treatments, and hill station tours with detailed pricing

## Pilgrimage & Spiritual Tourism

- [Kerala Pilgrim Centres](https://keralatourism.travel/kerala-pilgrim-centres): Complete guide to Hindu, Muslim, and Christian pilgrimage destinations throughout Kerala
- [Kerala Pilgrim Packages with Price & Itinerary](https://keralatourism.travel/kerala-pilgrim-centre-packages): Curated pilgrimage tour packages with pricing for temples including Padmanabhaswamy and Guruvayoor

## City & Regional Tours

- [Calicut City Tour Packages](https://keralatourism.travel/calicut-city-tour-packages): Explore Calicut (Kozhikode) coastal attractions and heritage sites with guided tour packages
